description: This file defines the DevOpsGuruClient class, a client used to interact with the Amazon DevOps Guru service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It declares method signatures for various operations and their asynchronous counterparts, indicating its role in providing API operations for AWS DevOps Guru.

classes.name: DevOpsGuruClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon DevOps Guru service, extending the base AwsClient class and providing methods for each API operation.

methods.name: addNotificationChannel
methods.description: Adds a notification channel for DevOps Guru notifications.

methods.name: addNotificationChannelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a notification channel for DevOps Guru notifications.

methods.name: deleteInsight
methods.description: Deletes a specific insight from DevOps Guru.

methods.name: describeAccountHealth
methods.description: Retrieves the health status of the AWS account within DevOps Guru.

methods.name: describeAccountHealthAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the account health status.

methods.name: describeAccountOverview
methods.description: Provides an overview of the AWS account's DevOps Guru insights.

methods.name: describeAccountOverviewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously provides an overview of the account.

methods.name: describeAnomaly
methods.description: Gets details about a specific anomaly.

methods.name: describeAnomalyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets details about an anomaly.

methods.name: describeEventSourcesConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration information for event sources.

methods.name: describeFeedback
methods.description: Retrieves feedback data for DevOps Guru.

methods.name: describeInsight
methods.description: Provides details about a specific insight.

methods.name: describeOrganizationHealth
methods.description: Gets the health of the organization in DevOps Guru.

methods.name: describeOrganizationOverview
methods.description: Provides an overview of the organization's DevOps insights.

methods.name: describeOrganizationResourceCollectionHealth
methods.description: Returns health information for a resource collection.

methods.name: describeOrganizationResourceCollectionHealthAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves resource collection health info.

methods.name: describeResourceCollectionHealth
methods.description: Provides health information for a resource collection.

methods.name: describeResourceCollectionHealthAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves resource collection health info.

methods.name: describeServiceIntegration
methods.description: Gets details about service integration settings.

methods.name: getResourceCollection
methods.description: Retrieves information about a resource collection.

methods.name: listAnomaliesForInsight
methods.description: Lists anomalies associated with a specific insight.

methods.name: listAnomaliesForInsightAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists anomalies for an insight.

methods.name: listMonitoredResources
methods.description: Lists resources monitored by DevOps Guru.
